color.note: Values verbatim from the app's :root (tokens/colors.css), the Toshi scope and the docs site (styles/docs.css). One light theme: the dark palette is for dark shells, not a theme.

tokens.name: d-blue
tokens.usage: Informational blue: links, sort arrows, the 2px ledger header rule, pagination, focus. Never a button fill. As link text on d-canvas 4.63:1; white text on it 4.85:1.

tokens.name: d-green
tokens.usage: Bright brand green for NON-TEXT accents only: icons, rings, dark-sidebar active text (7.83:1 on d-dark, 6.42:1 on d-dark-surface). Never text or a fill under text on light surfaces (2.28:1 with white).

tokens.name: d-amber
tokens.usage: Amber that warns: KPI amber tint and non-text warning marks (3.19:1 on white, meets 3:1 for icons only). Warning text and fills use d-warning.

tokens.name: d-accent
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill: green acts. White text on it 5.02:1 (darkened upstream 2026-09-18 from #22C55E).

tokens.name: d-accent-lt
tokens.usage: Light accent: the bright end of the LIVE badge gradient. Non-text.

tokens.name: d-accent-dk
tokens.usage: Hover fill for d-accent buttons; hover always goes darker.

tokens.name: d-success
tokens.usage: Success badges and alerts; not a button colour (the success button variant is retired).

tokens.name: d-success-dk
tokens.usage: Darker success, for hover and text on success tints.

tokens.name: d-warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill and text: AA-passing amber. White on it 5.02:1; as text on white 5.02:1.

tokens.name: d-warning-dk
tokens.usage: Darker warning, for hover and text on warning tints.

tokens.name: d-canvas
tokens.usage: Warm parchment page canvas behind every screen; cards sit on it in d-white.

tokens.name: d-surface
tokens.usage: Surface fill, same parchment as d-canvas; also the Toshi bot bubble.

tokens.name: d-white
tokens.usage: Card, table and input surfaces on d-canvas; text on d-accent, d-blue and the avatar tiles.

tokens.name: d-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on d-canvas (13.97:1) and d-white (14.63:1).

tokens.name: d-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, help and metadata on d-canvas (4.55:1) and d-white (4.76:1).

tokens.name: d-muted
tokens.usage: Muted marks and placeholders. Fails 4.5:1 as text on d-canvas (2.45:1) and d-white (2.56:1); kept exact from the source. Retired for icons; don't use it for text that must be read.

tokens.name: d-dark
tokens.usage: Darkest surface: dark shells and the Toshi review header.

tokens.name: d-dark-surface
tokens.usage: Raised dark surface and the fourth avatar tile.

tokens.name: d-dark-active
tokens.usage: Active item text in a dark sidebar (d-green: 7.83:1 on d-dark).

tokens.name: d-border
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline that bounds every card, input and table; also the resting ring.

tokens.name: d-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and emphasis border; promotes d-border.

tokens.name: d-avatar-ring
tokens.usage: Ring around the circular profile photo on the nav trigger only.

tokens.name: d-avatar-1
tokens.usage: Default initials avatar, id % 4 = 0. White letters 4.85:1.

tokens.name: d-avatar-2
tokens.usage: Default initials avatar, id % 4 = 1. White letters 5.02:1.

tokens.name: d-avatar-3
tokens.usage: Default initials avatar, id % 4 = 2. White letters 5.02:1.

tokens.name: d-avatar-4
tokens.usage: Default initials avatar, id % 4 = 3. White letters 14.63:1.

tokens.name: d-avatar-none
tokens.usage: Blank avatar tile when there is no name: no letters.

tokens.name: d-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon colour (Lucide, currentColor) on d-white, 14.6:1.

tokens.name: d-icon-active
tokens.usage: Icon on the active nav row (#E8EFE7), 7.78:1.

tokens.name: d-red
tokens.usage: Red that destroys: danger buttons and error states. White on it 4.83:1.

tokens.name: d-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and marks; disabled controls are exempt from contrast floors.

tokens.name: toshi-accent
tokens.usage: Toshi clay accent for fills and non-text marks; white on it 3.9:1, so not for small text.

tokens.name: toshi-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for every clay control, as shipped in toshi-ui.css (upstream token file still says #a84d32: drift flagged).

tokens.name: toshi-accent-deep
tokens.usage: Small-text clay ink where 4.5:1 is needed: 5.57:1 on toshi-bg.

tokens.name: toshi-warm-bg
tokens.usage: Warm fill inside the Toshi panel.

tokens.name: toshi-warm-text
tokens.usage: Body text in Toshi on toshi-bg (6.59:1) and toshi-warm-bg (5.98:1).

tokens.name: toshi-label-text
tokens.usage: Toshi labels. 3.65:1 on toshi-bg and 3.31:1 on toshi-warm-bg: passes only for text 24px+ or bold 19px+; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: toshi-title-text
tokens.usage: Toshi titles on toshi-bg (18.43:1) and toshi-warm-bg (16.72:1).

tokens.name: toshi-user-bubble
tokens.usage: The user's message bubble in Toshi.

tokens.name: kd-link
tokens.usage: Docs site link text: 6.40:1 on d-canvas (d-blue is borderline there).

tokens.name: kd-link-hover
tokens.usage: Docs site link hover: 9.89:1 on d-canvas.

tokens.name: kd-text-2
tokens.usage: Docs site secondary copy: 7.24:1 on d-canvas.

tokens.name: kd-mark
tokens.usage: Docs screenshot markers and highlight box; white numerals on it 6.47:1.

tokens.name: kd-tip-fg
tokens.usage: Docs tip callout text on kd-tip-bg, 8.70:1.

tokens.name: kd-note-fg
tokens.usage: Docs note callout text on kd-note-bg, 9.52:1.

tokens.name: kd-warn-fg
tokens.usage: Docs warning callout text on kd-warn-bg, 8.75:1.

tokens.name: kd-wa-fg
tokens.usage: Docs WhatsApp block text on kd-wa-bg, 8.70:1.

spacing.note: The px values that actually recur in the app CSS. Not a strict 4/8 grid: copy the literal.

tokens.name: d-space-5
tokens.usage: Compact cell padding-y, sticky bar padding.

tokens.name: d-space-7
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards and KPI tiles.

radius.note: Radius grows with the size of the container.

tokens.name: d-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Table wrapper, icon chips, Toshi cards.

shadow.note: The house elevation is a hairline ring, not a drop shadow. The ring-based d-ring and d-shadow-sm/md/lg/hover reference d-border and d-border-strong, so they stay in components/bundle.css.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the app states as tokens.

tokens.name: d-touch-target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every interactive target.

tokens.name: d-sticky-bar-h
tokens.usage: Sticky form action bar or page footer: 44px button + 12px top + 12px bottom.

tokens.name: d-toshi-sheet-w
tokens.usage: Toshi side sheet width at 768 to 1279px.

tokens.name: kd-toc-w
tokens.usage: Docs site table of contents column.

fontSize.note: The rem size scale as the app CSS repeats it; the type styles above use the same values.

tokens.name: d-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Labels, card and section titles, badges.

tokens.name: d-weight-bold
tokens.usage: Dashboard and page titles, KPI values.
